pages.text: Crouch and right-click snow with an empty main hand. Snow layers give snowballs; full blocks give one snow block. Four snowballs pack into one block in the player crafting grid.
Build a 2×2×2 interior with full snow walls, roof and snow floor. Leave a two-block-high entrance while building; close it with removable snow blocks when inside. Ice is a poorer insulator.
No bedding, wood or shovel required. Body heat gradually warms compact rooms; an empty igloo creates no heat. Monitor Body and Room. Severe frost remains dangerous.
